questions.prompt: Why is __syncthreads() needed between loading a shared tile and reading it?
options: So every thread's writes are complete and visible before any thread reads another's data
questions.explanation: Threads read data that other threads wrote; the barrier orders those accesses.

questions.prompt: Lane l reads 4-byte word 16·l of shared memory. What's the conflict degree?
questions.explanation: 16·l mod 32 takes only two values (0 and 16), each hit by 16 lanes with distinct words: 16-way.

questions.prompt: Lane l reads word 33·l + 5. What's the conflict degree?
All 32 lanes read the same shared-memory word. Cost?
questions.explanation: Reads of an identical word are broadcast.

questions.explanation: Every thread of the block must reach every barrier.

questions.prompt: Which make a 32×32 float tile's column reads conflict-free?
options: XOR-swizzling the column index with the row
questions.explanation: Padding and swizzling both spread a column across banks. Stride 32 is the problem itself.
